recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a browser-native, portrait-first top-down action collection game titled Echoes of the Verdant Relic. Preserve a large bounded world, camera-follow player movement, virtual joystick controls, separate Claim and Strike buttons, nearby item pickup/equip, melee arc attacks with cooldown/reach/damage/knockback, enemy pursuit and contact damage, score from enemy defeat, persistent item collection index, start/menu/index/game-over/restart states, and escalating enemy pressure.

Express the game as a Zelda-like mythic overworld quest: the player is a green-and-gold grove knight, collectible weapons are ancient relic tools, enemies are dungeon shades, score is Heroic Renown, health is Courage Hearts, and the persistent collection is a Lore Index. Use procedural canvas/DOM art for forest gradients, ancient rune geometry, ruin markers, glowing relic medallions, smoky shade silhouettes, sword arcs, particles, and fantasy menu crests. Optimize for mobile portrait aspect ratios from 4:7 to 9:16 with readable HUD, thumb-reachable controls, and clear CTAs.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile top-down free-roam action collection arena
- objective: roam a large canvas world, pick up weapon/relic items, attack pursuing enemies, increase score by defeating enemies, and expand a persistent collection index by discovering item variants.
- input model: mobile virtual joystick for movement, two touch buttons for claim/grab and strike/attack, plus keyboard fallback for desktop testing.
- core loop: start run -> move through world -> collect a nearby tool -> attack chasing hazards -> earn score and possible drops -> survive escalating spawns -> game over and restart/menu.
- fail/friction state: player health/courage is reduced by enemy contact; at zero the run enters a game-over overlay with final score and restart/menu choices.

## Protected mechanics
- Free-roam top-down movement inside a bounded large world with camera follow.
- Joystick/touch movement and separate claim/strike actions with keyboard fallback.
- Nearby item pickup that equips one held weapon/tool and unlocks it in a persistent index.
- Melee cone/arc attack with cooldown, reach, damage, knockback, and enemy hit checks.
- Enemies spawn over time, pursue the player, damage on contact, and die for score.
- Score increases by enemy defeat; collection count persists separately in localStorage.
- Start, index, gameplay, game-over, restart, and menu state flow.

## Remixed target
Echoes of the Verdant Relic is a portrait-first Zelda-like mythic overworld quest. The same arena survival/collection mechanics are reinterpreted as a grove knight exploring a living ruin, claiming ancient relic tools, logging hidden secrets in a Lore Index, striking dungeon shades, and preserving courage hearts. The remake uses procedural canvas/DOM art, fantasy typography, approved forest audio, and mobile-safe controls while avoiding new gameplay rules that would alter the source loop.
